mentions.name: Pronto
mentions.description: A world news system built with MCP (Model Context Protocol) that powers decision making and monitoring of other systems the author curates. It experiments with agent-communication formats more efficient than JSON and stress-tests whether the curated framework can handle load and traffic.
mentions.problem: Exploring agent-communication formats more efficient than JSON and validating that the curated framework can handle load and traffic.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on https://pronto.stream/, I wanted to mess around with MCP and building a world news system to power the decision making and surveillance of other systems I would likely curate.
mentions.author: MomohNobert
